## Master Architecture Optimization

This change tightens the master architecture around explicit system invariants without asserting implementation status.

### Changes
- Adds an Architecture Kernel for authority, canonical state ownership, command/query/event semantics, deterministic boundaries, failure semantics and version compatibility.
- Makes persistence and finality separate architectural properties.
- Clarifies the trust hierarchy for AI, applications, integration services, deterministic runtimes and canonical state.
- Adds explicit optimization rules for single state ownership, contract ownership, control-plane enforcement, recovery and duplicate implementations.
- Aligns the canonical blockchain runtime/data-flow diagram with those semantics.

### Evidence rule
Architecture remains separate from specification, implementation, testing, exact-SHA CI and E2E evidence.
